name: Nether Earth GS: workspace
summary: The work space $FCE9-$FFFF: the variables, the IM 2 vector and table, the buildings, as the file holds them.

entries.name: ImJump
entries.summary: The IM 2 vector: JP Handler, the interrupt handler of the moment

labels.name: N1Leftover
labels.comment: Nether Earth's tape loader N1 from its 16th byte, as the memory dump kept it

labels.name: Variables
labels.comment: The game's variables $FD00-$FDFC (their names below); in the file N1's bytes and zeros

labels.name: RandomSeed
labels.comment: the shift register of Random, seeded $39,$30,$39,$30 by Start

labels.name: PrintAddr
labels.comment: the screen address of the next printed character

labels.name: MapView
labels.comment: the map byte at the view's left column: $DD00 + ViewX

labels.name: SavedSP
labels.comment: SP kept while ClearViewBuffer pushes and while the menu music runs

labels.name: ViewX
labels.comment: the map column at the view's left edge, follows ShipX

labels.name: Input
labels.comment: the controls read this game turn: bit 0 right, 1 left, 2 down, 3 up, 4 fire, 5 save, 6 abort, 7 pause

labels.name: ShipY
labels.comment: the ship's row, 1-15

labels.name: ShipX
labels.comment: the ship's column, $000E-$01F5

labels.name: Altitude
labels.comment: the ship's height: fire raises it by 2 to $30, released it sinks by 1 to what is under it

labels.name: ShipDrawPos
labels.comment: the ship's view position while its drawing is deferred (column, row); 0 = not deferred

labels.name: PrintAttr
labels.comment: the attribute of printed characters

labels.name: PrintAttrAddr
labels.comment: the attribute address of the next printed character

labels.name: PrintHeight
labels.comment: big characters: each font row printed this many times (PrintInline code 4, high nibble)

labels.name: PrintWidth
labels.comment: big characters: the width in bytes, 0 normal (PrintInline code 4, low nibble)

labels.name: RadarPhase
labels.comment: toggled each frame: 0 shows the player's radar layer, 1 the enemy's

labels.name: RadarLeft
labels.comment: the radar window's left edge in units of 8 map columns, 0-$30

labels.name: RadarColumn
labels.comment: RadarLeft x 8: the radar window's first map column

labels.name: RadarBlink
labels.comment: bit 0: the ship's radar blip is drawn

labels.name: MenuCursor
labels.comment: the construction menu: the column (0 EXIT MENU, 1 START ROBOT, 2 the parts), the part row; the robot menu: its last item

labels.name: MenuParts
labels.comment: the parts chosen, bit = part row; the new robot's +$07

labels.name: Resources
labels.comment: general, electronics, nuclear, phasers, missiles, cannon, chassis

labels.name: MenuResources
labels.comment: the copy the construction menu spends; back to Resources on START ROBOT

labels.name: ClimbTurns
labels.comment: game turns the ship still climbs by itself: 3 at a new game, 5 after a menu

labels.name: PrintColumn
labels.comment: the print position's column

labels.name: PrintRow
labels.comment: the print position's row

labels.name: TitleColourPhase
labels.comment: 0-15, TitleColourCycle's frame counter

labels.name: TurnFrames
labels.comment: frames counted by PlayInterrupt; a game turn waits for 10

labels.name: Clock
labels.comment: minutes (by 5), hours, days (16 bits)

labels.name: PanelBusy
labels.comment: 1 while a robot menu owns the right panel

labels.name: PlayerBuildings
labels.comment: the player's buildings by type: warbases, then factories in the Resources order

labels.name: PlayerRobotCount
labels.comment: live robots in slots 0-23

labels.name: EnemyBuildings
labels.comment: the enemy's buildings, the same order; no warbase left = the game is won

labels.name: EnemyRobotCount
labels.comment: live robots in slots 24-47

labels.name: EnemyResources
labels.comment: the enemy's resources, the order of Resources

labels.name: Side
labels.comment: the side being processed: 0 the player's, 1 the enemy's

labels.name: RadarDirty
labels.comment: 1: rebuild the radar layers from the map at the next ship mark

labels.name: SoundFx
labels.comment: 1-$7F a falling tone (fire), $FC a miss, $FA a hit, $C8 a robot destroyed; PlayInterrupt counts it on

labels.name: BassReturnPos
labels.comment: menu music: the bass track's return point

labels.name: LeadReturnPos
labels.comment: menu music: the lead track's return point

labels.name: Warbases
labels.comment: 4 capture points of 5 bytes: X (2), Y, owner (bit 6 player, 5 enemy, 7 destroyed) + type, turns a robot has stood at the door (144 captures)

labels.name: Factories
labels.comment: 24 capture points of 5 bytes, the same shape

labels.name: ImTable
labels.comment: The IM 2 vector table: 257 bytes of $FD

labels.name: Buildings
labels.comment: 56 building records of 3 bytes: the map cell address, the type

labels.name: StackArea
labels.comment: The stack's bytes and other leftovers to $FFFF
